checks.title: Requested variables present in source files
checks.message: All 13 raw variables found in 3 file(s).

checks.title: Real vs synthetic data
checks.message: Official source files were used (MD5 recorded in provenance).

checks.title: Appropriate sample weight
checks.message: subsample weight (WTSSTT2Y) matches the most restrictive component used; weights rescaled by cycle length when combining cycles.

checks.title: Analytic weights positive and non-missing
checks.message: 0 analytic records with missing/zero weight. Weighted population represented: 232.4 million.

checks.title: Design degrees of freedom
checks.message: Analytic population spans 31 PSUs in 14 strata (df = 17). NCHS flags estimates with df < 8.

checks.title: Events per model parameter
checks.message: 909 events, 3350 non-events, 10 parameters -> 90.9 per parameter (rule of thumb >= 10).

checks.title: Outcome missingness
checks.message: 0.0% of the eligible population lacks the outcome (0 of 4588). Missing outcome is assumed missing at random within the design.

checks.title: Complete-case loss
checks.message: 7.2% of the analytic sample (329) lack >=1 covariate.

checks.title: Raw values within plausible ranges
checks.message: 13 raw variables checked against dictionary ranges; non-response codes recoded to missing.

checks.title: NCHS presentation standards for proportions
checks.message: 38 of 39 estimates meet the standard; 1 should be suppressed, 0 flagged for review.

checks.title: No implausible effect sizes
checks.message: All ratio estimates within 0.1-10 with SE(log) < 2.5.

checks.title: Model size vs design degrees of freedom
checks.message: Primary model has 11 parameters; design df = 17. Wald tests and CIs use the design df (t distribution).

checks.title: Sensitivity analyses agree with primary result
checks.message: 1 of 1 sensitivity analyses agree in direction (associations) or magnitude (prevalence).

checks.title: Age top-coding
checks.message: NHANES top-codes age at 80 years; age is modelled as continuous with this censoring.
